name: From GitHub ticket to code
description: Have Claude Code fix your GitHub issues for you, with your approval: it gathers each issue's full context (text, comments, screenshots, attachments), one at a time or for a whole Project board at once, then investigates, reproduces and makes the minimal fix, runs your tests and hands you a commit or a pull request linked back on the issue. Installs the GitHub CLI when needed. Works on any repository, any kind of bug or small feature.
